meta.description: Single source of truth for Imelda Mutio's public footprint. The website reads this file. Only entries with "publish": true appear on the live site. Every entry keeps its verification status and evidence so the register can be audited.
meta.researcher: Compiled for Imelda Mutio's personal brand website

verificationKey.verified: Confirmed by an original or primary source that was opened and read.
verificationKey.partial: Supported by a credible source, but seen only in a search snippet or missing a detail.
verificationKey.self-reported: Appears only in Imelda's own materials (portfolio PDF, her own posts). Needs her confirmation and, ideally, a public source.

entries.title: The Mid-Morning Show, Classic 105
entries.summary: I host the Mid-Morning Show on weekdays: music, stories, lifestyle conversations, guest interviews and my daily Dilemma of the Day.
entries.demonstrates: Five hours of live radio every weekday.
entries.evidence: Imelda's portfolio PDF; Classic 105's own Facebook post (Oct 2026) says 'Catch Imelda Mutio on the Mid-Morning Show on Classic 105 FM, keeping you company from 10 AM to 3 PM'. Her LinkedIn headline also lists the 10am to 3pm slot. Seen as search snippets.
entries.rights: Text only. No station logo used.
